title: Tunisian Chilli Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion of Tunisian and Mexican flavors, this dish combines the spices of tagine with the heat of chilli in a taco.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chilli peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the cumin powder, tagine spices, and harissa, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Fill the taco shells with the tagine mixture and serve.
